Maximum dimension Length Width Height
Max ≤ 1000 mm Max ≤ 1000 mm Max ≤ 1000 mm
Minimum dimension Min ≥ 50 mm Min ≥ 50 mm Min ≥ 50 mm
Scale interval d ≥ 5 mm d ≥ 5 mm d ≥ 5 mm

humidity non-condensing
